answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because gale only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, quill is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any ocean approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
